summary: This paper (ISCAS 2025) presents a digital beamforming architecture using 2D FFT for satellite payloads, with FPGA implementation using Vivado HLS and VITIS HLS on a VCU129EK board. No code availability statement appears in the paper. Thorough searching across GitHub (repo search, code search, author profile checks) and web search found no repository associated with this work. The paper is part of the ESA EGERTON project, whose public pages also do not link to any source code. I am confident this paper does not have a publicly available GitHub repository.
